qualification_definitions.pair_qualification: Current positive wave price>historical wave price AND current positive wave DIF<historical wave DIF, strict extrema, causal prefix.
qualification_definitions.raw: Take last two completed positive sign segments, then filter and choose strongest.
qualification_definitions.pair_filtered: Filter entire completed positive history by current price/DIF relation, take last two survivors, then choose strongest.
qualification_definitions.ever_dull: Take last two historical positive segments that had any positive-direction DULL under unchanged strongest candidate, then filter; candidate-defined, not software facts.
